items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The descriptor guards are clear. The new query.py block has no comment explaining it and includes a very long condition: `if rel_obj is not None and hasattr(rel_obj, 'get_deferred_fields') and rel_obj.get_deferred_fields():`. The added test also contains print statements.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The patch adds deferred-field special-casing to prefetch_related_objects, which mixes concerns across layers. It leaves debug `print("Deferred on house:", ...)` calls in tests/prefetch_related/tests.py, an existing test file. It also adds two descriptor guards that were not needed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `except exceptions.ObjectDoesNotExist: continue` silently skips objects. `obj_to_fetch = obj_list` whenever a custom queryset exists forces refetches and breaks the duplicate-query and is_fetched P2P tests.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK and ReverseOneToOne paths both have a correct `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)` guard. However, the extra query.py deferred-field hack refetches all objects that have custom querysets, adding extra queries; F2P 0/1 and 2 P2P tests fail.
